questions.stem: The Greek root 'bio' means 'life'. What is the exact fundamental meaning of 'biology'?

options.option_text: The mathematical calculation of the exact age of ancient rocks and minerals.
The scientific study of living organisms and their vital biological processes.
The deep historical study of ancient extinct human civilizations and empires.
The precise astronomical observation of distant stars and solar systems.

questions.explanation: 'Biology' combines 'bio' (life) and 'logy' (study of). It is the natural science that explicitly studies life and living organisms.

questions.stem: The Greek root 'graph' means 'to write'. What exactly is an 'autograph'?

options.option_text: An automated robotic machine that quickly writes thousands of identical letters.
A digitally printed photograph of a famous historical political figure.
A person's own unique signature, typically handwritten as a memorable souvenir.
A highly secretive invisible ink used by military spies during wartime.

questions.explanation: 'Autograph' combines 'auto' (self) and 'graph' (write). It literally means 'written by oneself', commonly referring to a signature.

questions.stem: Combining 'bio' (life) and 'graph' (write), what is the literary definition of a 'biography'?

options.option_text: A fictional novel entirely based on mythological ancient Greek gods.
A scientific textbook extensively detailing human anatomy and physiology.
A completely daily personal diary secretly kept by a famous politician.
A detailed written account of someone's life, written by someone else.

questions.explanation: 'Biography' combines 'bio' (life) and 'graphia' (writing). It is a detailed description of a person's life written by another person.

options.option_text: An account of a person's life history written by that person themselves.
A strictly authorized biography officially written by a professional hired author.
A heavily edited documentary film exclusively covering a celebrity's career.
A short, fictionalized story vaguely inspired by true historical events.

questions.explanation: 'Autobiography' literally translates to 'self-life-writing'. It is a self-written account of the life of oneself.

questions.stem: The Greek prefix 'amphi-' means 'both' and 'bio' means 'life'. Biologically, what exactly is an 'amphibian'?

options.option_text: A large predatory mammal that strictly hunts only deep inside dense tropical jungles.
A specialized deep-sea fish that can only survive in extremely cold saltwater.
A cold-blooded vertebrate animal capable of successfully living both on land and in water.
A highly venomous desert snake that absolutely requires intensely dry arid heat.

questions.explanation: 'Amphibian' combines 'amphi' (both kinds) and 'bios' (life). It refers to animals like frogs that have an aquatic gill-breathing larval stage followed by a terrestrial lung-breathing adult stage.

questions.stem: The root 'graph' means 'write' or 'record'. Scientifically, what specific crucial function does a 'seismograph' accurately perform?

options.option_text: It accurately tracks and records the exact migration patterns of deep-sea whales.
It precisely measures and visually records the details, force, and duration of earthquakes.
It continuously writes and prints daily national weather forecasts and temperatures.
It chemically analyzes and writes a detailed report on local soil acidity.

questions.explanation: 'Seismograph' combines 'seismos' (earthquake) and 'graph' (instrument for recording). It is an instrument that measures and records details of earthquakes.

questions.stem: Using 'syn-' (together) and 'bio' (life), what is the strict biological definition of 'symbiosis'?

options.option_text: The sudden violent destruction of one entire species strictly caused by a dominant predator.
The completely independent and isolated evolutionary development of two separate identical species.
The aggressive deadly parasitic infection that rapidly fully kills the primary host organism.
A mutually beneficial interaction or close physical association between two different biological organisms.

questions.explanation: 'Symbiosis' combines 'syn' (together) and 'biosis' (living). In biology, it denotes any type of a close and long-term biological interaction between two different biological organisms.
